jung_input: five-phase current, 128 points, per-phase midpoint centering and one shared window scale; preserves inter-phase amplitude ratios
jung_noise_augmentation: record-level SNR-AWGN with short-time-RMS quiet-current gate; noise power recalibrated to requested global phase-wise SNR
hang_input: fundamental five-phase VSD alpha-beta trajectory, per-time vector-magnitude normalization, one 40x40 image channel
hang_network: five 3x3 Conv2D stages with 4/8/16/32/64 channels; fixed Haar LL pooling after stages 1 and 2; 40x40 -> 20x20 -> 10x10 before final convolution and classifier
selection: source clean F1 within one percentage point of peak; maximize mean source validation F1 at 0/5/10/20/30 dB; ties by clean F1, then minimum mean CE, then earliest epoch
faithfulness: paper-informed task adaptation, not author code; Hang uses a five-phase fundamental-VSD analogue of the paper's normalized Clarke trajectory; Jung uses a generic quiet-current gate because NPC switch-specific topology is unavailable
changes_from_cycle_v2: Jung input uses phase-shared normalization instead of independent per-phase normalization
Jung training noise suppresses perturbations in sustained low-current intervals while preserving the requested record-level SNR
Hang trajectory uses instantaneous vector normalization rather than a window-global scale
Hang input changes from two 64x64 VSD planes to one 40x40 fundamental-plane trajectory
Hang training follows the paper's clean-image training rather than paired clean/noisy cross-entropy
